Research question: "What analyses or measurements would best test whether AP-1 acts as a cellular memory mechanism?"

Propose 5 distinct, concrete ideas (analyses, measurements, or experiments) that a research lab could pursue to address this question. For each idea give a short title and a description of one or two sentences.

ideas.title: Ruins after the king: AP-1 occupancy vs. persistent chromatin after signal withdrawal
ideas.description: Stimulate cells (e.g., macrophages or fibroblasts) with a transient signal, then withdraw it and run time-course CUT&RUN/ATAC-seq for FOS/JUN occupancy and accessibility. Like the Ozymandias statue's legs outlasting the king, test whether accessible, H3K27ac/H3K4me1-marked enhancers persist after AP-1 itself has left, which would indicate AP-1 acts as a trigger that leaves a memory scar rather than needing continuous presence.

ideas.title: Acute degradation to separate initiation from maintenance
ideas.description: Use auxin/dTAG degron alleles of FOS/JUN family members (or a dominant-negative A-Fos) at different times: before, during, and long after the priming stimulus. If memory requires AP-1 only at priming but not at recall, it is an initiator; if depletion during the memory phase erases enhanced re-induction, AP-1 is the maintenance mechanism.

ideas.title: Prime–rest–restimulate transcriptional recall assay with motif-dependent enhancers
ideas.description: Measure RNA-seq/PRO-seq of faster or stronger re-induction after a second stimulus following a rest period, and link genes with memory to AP-1 motif content. Validate with CRISPR deletion or base-editing of AP-1 motifs at specific memory enhancers and reporter assays to show the motif is necessary for the primed response.

ideas.title: Single-cell lineage tracking of AP-1 history and heritability
ideas.description: Combine live-cell AP-1 reporters (or FOS-GFP knock-in) with single-cell multiome (RNA+ATAC) and barcoded lineages to ask whether sister cells share the primed state after division and the stimulus is gone. Heritability across divisions, beyond what shared environment explains, would show memory is cell-intrinsic, and the loss of the state over generations would quantify its decay time, like sand slowly erasing a monument.

ideas.title: Pioneer-like activity and cooperative chromatin remodeling in vitro
ideas.description: Test whether AP-1 can open nucleosomal DNA and recruit SWI/SNF (BAF) using reconstituted nucleosome binding assays, single-molecule footprinting, and BAF inhibitor/degrader experiments in cells. If BAF recruitment is required for retained accessibility after AP-1 leaves, it supplies a mechanistic link between transient AP-1 binding and a durable epigenetic state.
